Bug_Title: Unnecessary equality checks should not be made
Bug_Explanation: The code contains unnecessary equality checks between dissimilar types which will always return false. These include comparisons between unrelated classes, unrelated class and interface, unrelated interfaces, an array with a non-array, two incompatible arrays, and an object with null.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the showBug method, which contains multiple unnecessary equality checks that always return false. The test will fail because showBug incorrectly returns true when these equality checks are made, triggering the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully with 'OK (1 test)', which means that the method 'showBug' returned 'false' as expected by the test. This does not confirm the bug was triggered, as the presence of the bug would have resulted in a 'true' return, causing the test to fail.
